Umbraco.description: Configuration container for all Umbraco products.

UmbracoAutomateDefinition.description:
Root Umbraco.Automate configuration (Umbraco:Automate). Inherits the
root-level switches from AutomateOptions and adds the
known sub-section options as nested objects.

UseNamedConnectionString.description:
Gets or sets the name of the connection string Automate resolves from
ConnectionStrings. Defaults to umbracoAutomateDbDSN so a standard
dedicated configuration just works. Set to umbracoDbDSN to share the
Umbraco CMS database, or to any other named entry so multiple products can share
a single DSN.

AllowedConfigurationKeyPrefixes.description:
Gets or sets the IConfiguration key
prefixes that automation settings may dereference via the $Key:Path syntax.

SecretConfigurationKeyPrefixes.description:
Gets or sets the subset of AllowedConfigurationKeyPrefixes whose values
are treated as secret, and which may therefore only be referenced from settings fields
marked [Field(IsSensitive = true)].

WebhookOptions.description:
Configuration options for the webhook endpoint.
Bound to Umbraco:Automate:Webhook in appsettings.json.

MaxPayloadBytes.description:
Gets or sets the maximum allowed webhook payload size in bytes.
Requests exceeding this limit are rejected with 413 Payload Too Large.
Default: 1 MB.

RateLimitPerMinute.description:
Gets or sets the maximum number of webhook requests per automation per minute.
Requests exceeding this limit are rejected with 429 Too Many Requests.
Default: 100.

ExecutionOptions.description:
Configuration options for automation execution.
Bound to Umbraco:Automate:Execution in appsettings.json.

DefaultTimeout.description: Gets or sets the default timeout per step.

DefaultMaxRetries.description:
Gets or sets the default maximum number of retries for a failed step when the
step's own MaxRetries is not set.
Prevents a transient failure from retrying indefinitely.

DefaultRetryInterval.description:
Gets or sets the default retry interval for a failed step when the step's own
RetryInterval is not set. Without this, WorkflowCore
falls back to its built-in 60-second default.

MaxConcurrentRuns.description:
Gets or sets the maximum number of workflow executions each node processes at the same
time. Set to 0 or less to use WorkflowCore's default of the processor count, with a
minimum of 4. Default: 0.

PollInterval.description:
Gets or sets how often WorkflowCore polls persistence for workflows that are ready to
run, such as a run whose delay has elapsed. Values of zero or less use the default.
Default: 10 seconds, matching WorkflowCore's own default.

MaxChainDepth.description:
Gets or sets the maximum automation chain depth. When an event carries a chain
depth at or above this limit, the dispatcher drops it instead of starting another
run. Hard backstop against runaway cascades; per-trigger
SkipAutomationOriginatedEvents is the first line of defence.

MaxInlineOutputBytes.description:
Gets or sets the maximum size, in UTF-8 encoded bytes, of a step's serialized output
that is inlined into the WorkflowCore workflow data (which is re-serialized on every
execution pass). Larger outputs are stored only on the step run record — written once —
and referenced from the workflow data, hydrated on demand when a binding reads them.
Default: 16 KB.

MaxHttpResponseBodyBytes.description:
Gets or sets the maximum HTTP response body size, in bytes, accepted by the built-in
HTTP Request action. Responses exceeding the limit fail the step with an actionable
error instead of flooding run storage with megabytes of payload. Default: 10 MB.

MaxMediaFileBytes.description:
Gets or sets the maximum size, in bytes, of a file the Create Media action will download
and store. Separate from MaxHttpResponseBodyBytes: that caps a payload held
in run storage, whereas this caps a file written to the media filesystem, so a site that
imports large assets can raise one without loosening the other. Default: 10 MB.

AllowOutboundHttpProxy.description:
Gets or sets whether outbound HTTP requests made by automations (HTTP Request, Run Script
fetch(), Create Media downloads, webhook notification channels) may be routed through
the system or environment-configured proxy. Default: true.

MinimumLogLevel.description:
Gets or sets the minimum level of action log entry (see ActionLogLevel)
captured during step execution. Entries below this level are never persisted. Lower
to Debug to troubleshoot a specific automation, or raise
to Warning/Error to cut noise.
Default: Info.

MaxLogEntriesPerStep.description:
Gets or sets the maximum number of log entries retained per step, guarding against a
runaway loop spamming entries. Applies independently of MinimumLogLevel.
Default: 200.

Mode.description: Gets or sets the execution mode for workflow processing.

ActionLogLevel.description: Severity of a log entry recorded by an action during execution.

ExecutionMode.description: Controls which nodes participate in workflow execution.

ScriptingOptions.description:
Configuration options for the Run Script action's sandboxed JavaScript execution.
Bound to Umbraco:Automate:Scripting in appsettings.json.

Enabled.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether the Run Script action is enabled at all.
When false, the action fails fast with a configuration error and scripts are
rejected at save time — a tenant-wide kill switch. Default: true.

FetchEnabled.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether scripts may use fetch at all. This is a
master switch: when false, fetch is never exposed regardless of a step's
own AllowFetch toggle. Default: true.

FetchAllowedHosts.description:
Gets or sets an optional allowlist of hosts a script's fetch may target. When
empty, any host is allowed (subject to SSRF protection). When non-empty, only these
hosts are permitted. Default: empty.

MaxMemoryBytes.description: Gets or sets the maximum memory, in bytes, a single script may allocate. Default: 5 MB.

MaxRecursionDepth.description: Gets or sets the maximum recursion depth a script may reach. Default: 64.

MaxArraySize.description: Gets or sets the maximum array size a script may create. Default: 1000.

MaxStatements.description: Gets or sets the maximum number of statements a single script may execute. Default: 10,000.

StatementTimeout.description: Gets or sets the per-statement timeout enforced by the engine. Default: 3 seconds.

TotalExecutionTimeout.description:
Gets or sets the total wall-clock time a script may run before it is cancelled — the
backstop against never-resolving promises. Capped by the step timeout at execution time.
Default: 15 seconds.

HttpRequestTimeout.description: Gets or sets the timeout for a single fetch HTTP request. Default: 5 seconds.

MaxResponseBodyBytes.description:
Gets or sets the maximum size, in bytes, of a fetch response body a script may
read. Default: 10 MB.

OutboxOptions.description:
Configuration options for the outbox message dispatcher.
Bound to Umbraco:Automate:Outbox in appsettings.json.

PollInterval.description: How often the dispatcher polls for new messages.

MaxRetries.description: Maximum number of delivery attempts before dead-lettering.

BaseRetryDelay.description:
Base delay for exponential backoff between retries.
Actual delay = BaseRetryDelay * 2^retryCount.

StaleClaimThreshold.description:
How long a claimed message can be held before it's considered stale
and released for another instance to pick up (handles process crashes).

CompletedRetention.description: How long to keep completed messages before cleanup removes them.

DrainTimeout.description:
Grace period during shutdown: the dispatcher stops claiming new messages
but waits up to this duration for any in-flight message to finish processing.

MaxPendingMessages.description:
Maximum number of pending messages allowed in the outbox.
When the limit is reached, new publish calls are rejected with OutboxBackpressureException.
Set to 0 to disable the limit.

VersionCleanupPolicy.description: Configuration options for automated version history cleanup.

Enabled.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether version cleanup is enabled.
Default is true.

MaxVersionsPerEntity.description:
Gets or sets the maximum number of versions to retain per entity.
Set to 0 to disable count-based cleanup. Default is 50.

RetentionDays.description:
Gets or sets the number of days to retain version history.
Set to 0 to disable age-based cleanup. Default is 90 days.

RunCleanupPolicy.description: Configuration for automatic cleanup of old automation run records.

Enabled.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether automatic run cleanup is enabled.

RetentionDays.description:
Gets or sets the maximum age (in days) for run records. Runs older than this are deleted.
Set to 0 or less to disable age-based cleanup.

MaxRunsPerAutomation.description:
Gets or sets the maximum number of run records to keep per automation.
Set to 0 or less to disable count-based cleanup.

ScheduledTriggerOptions.description:
Configuration options for the scheduled trigger background job.
Bound to Umbraco:Automate:ScheduledTrigger in appsettings.json.

PollInterval.description: Gets or sets the poll interval for checking scheduled triggers.

StartupDelay.description: Gets or sets the startup delay before the first poll.

MaxJitter.description:
Gets or sets the maximum jitter applied to scheduled triggers configured as
Flexible. Each automation gets a deterministic
per-id offset within [0, MaxJitter], spreading load when many automations
share a CRON tick. Set to Zero to disable jitter entirely.

RateLimitingOptions.description:
Configuration options for per-automation rate limiting.
Bound to Umbraco:Automate:RateLimiting in appsettings.json.

Enabled.description: Gets or sets whether rate limiting is enabled.

MaxRunsPerAutomationPerMinute.description: Gets or sets the maximum number of runs per automation per minute.

MaxConcurrentRunsPerAutomation.description: Gets or sets the maximum number of concurrent runs per automation.

CircuitBreakerOptions.description:
Configuration options for the circuit breaker that auto-disables a "sick" automation
(one failing on every trigger due to misconfiguration).
Bound to Umbraco:Automate:CircuitBreaker in appsettings.json.

Enabled.description: Gets or sets whether the circuit breaker is enabled globally.

ConsecutiveWarningThreshold.description:
Gets or sets the number of consecutive failures that issues a degradation warning
(transitions to Degraded). Set lower than
ConsecutiveFailureThreshold so the warning is reachable in the common
"keeps failing" path before the disable threshold trips.

ConsecutiveFailureThreshold.description: Gets or sets the number of consecutive failures before an automation is disabled.

WarningErrorRate.description: Gets or sets the error rate (0.0–1.0) over the evaluation window that triggers a warning.

DisableErrorRate.description: Gets or sets the error rate (0.0–1.0) over the evaluation window that triggers auto-disable.

EvaluationWindowSize.description:
Gets or sets the number of recent terminal runs evaluated for the error-rate calculation.
Error-rate thresholds only apply once at least this many terminal runs exist.

GracePeriodAfterWarning.description:
Gets or sets the grace period after a warning before auto-disable can trigger,
giving the owner time to investigate and fix.

WorkflowLockOptions.description:
Configuration options for the EF Core-backed WorkflowCore distributed lock provider.
Bound to Umbraco:Automate:WorkflowLock in appsettings.json.

LeaseDuration.description:
How long an acquired lease is valid before another node may steal it. Bounds how long a
crashed holder can block other nodes from processing the same workflow instance, and how long
a starting node waits for another node's heartbeat before treating that node as gone.

RenewalInterval.description:
How often a held lease's expiry is pushed forward, so a lock doesn't lapse mid-use during
a slow step, and how often a node writes its heartbeat. Must be shorter than
LeaseDuration.
